_comment: Starter expected-coverage manifest for scripts/bench.py: scenario id -> {name, source, expected_classes}. expected_classes use scripts/coverage-classes.json vocabulary (the same class names the Approach.md 4a board and the hunt routing table use; e.g. auth not auth-bypass, race-condition not race-conditions). This is a starter set of 10 PortSwigger Web Security Academy labs across distinct classes -- extend it by adding scenario ids; keep class names from coverage-classes.json so the board match works. Scored with: python3 scripts/bench.py --eng targets/<name>

ps-sqli-union-columns.name: SQL injection UNION attack, determining the number of columns returned by an applicable query

ps-xss-reflected-html.name: Reflected XSS into HTML context with nothing encoded

ps-ssrf-local.name: Basic SSRF against the local server

ps-upload-web-shell.name: Remote code execution via web shell upload
